metadata.value: two-stage training: frozen backbone with trainable linear head (transfer-phase), then unfreezing layers (finetune-phase)
metadata.normalized_value: two-stage training: frozen backbone with trainable linear head (transfer-phase), then unfreezing layers (finetune-phase)
metadata.evidence:
The trainer first loads a pretrained `model_backbone` from the Keras hub and then
conducts training in two stages. First, the backbone itself is frozen and only a linear
head on top of the backbone is trainable (`transfer`-phase).
Second, parts or the full `model_backbone` is unfrozen and more parts of the network
can be adapted (`finetune`-phase).
metadata.reason: Describes the transfer learning / fine-tuning training strategy implemented by WildlifeTrainer.
